summary: A committed schema and its fixtures were validated by a deterministic check that executed no part of the behaviour the claim is about.

executedComponents.note: Reads committed files. No network, no cluster, no model, no clock.

workload.description: No request was issued. The check reads files.

results.statement: Every valid fixture validated and every invalid fixture was refused by the rule the matrix names.

limitations: The schema and its fixtures are files. Nothing consumed the contract at run time.
doesNotEstablish: That any workload was ever deployed from a contract document.
